reviews.title: Great replacement for my DDR4 modules.
reviews.comment: I got this due to a catastrophic crash in my system that was isolated to a bad memory module(s). These matched up spec wise to my HyperX Fury DDR4 modules. Thought I had them in all the way but they were a bit tight so the pc didn't boot, it tried though. I saw a tiny rise in 2 of the modules and reinserted them. BIOS had to do it's thing and the system now runs faster than it did before. I guess the old ones were getting ready to fail for awhile. Great service and price, I got them the next morning and got to work. The quality is on par for the DDR4 requirements and these white ones replaced my Fury black ones. Passed all stability testing Win 11 could throw at it. Glad I still know command line codes.
reviews.author: 15 year Customer

reviews.title: What a bargain!
reviews.comment: Bought this for my son for his birthday. He loves it! Great price and works well! It came fast, no trouble with delivery. Exactly what else expected. Quality is good. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: BamaGirl

reviews.title: RAM works as expected.
reviews.comment: I was skeptical about this RAM since I never heard of the brand before. I usually don’t write reviews but figured I would to help others decide. My PC recognized the RAM without any trouble. Small FPS boost coming from 16gb to 32gb. Looks sweet too. Edit: I realized my pc was only running these at 2400mhz. I had to go into bios and turn on xmp in the ai tweaking section to get the full juice out of it. No issues.
